import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/field_visit_log.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Visit Log', header=None)
header = df_raw.iloc[4].tolist()
data = df_raw.iloc[5:].copy()
data.columns = header

# Drop rows where Visit ID is NaN
data = data[data['Visit ID'].notna()]

# Normalise village names
def normalize_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return ''
    s = str(v)
    s = s.strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

data['Village_norm'] = data['Village'].apply(normalize_village)

# Normalise district for comparison (trim, collapse whitespace, case-insensitive)
def normalize_district(d):
    if pd.isna(d):
        return ''
    s = str(d).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

data['District_norm'] = data['District'].apply(normalize_district)

# Deduplicate Visit ID by keeping first spreadsheet occurrence
# Keep original order
data = data.reset_index(drop=True)
data_dedup = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')

# Filter for Gadchiroli district
gadchiroli_mask = data_dedup['District_norm'] == 'gadchiroli'
gadchiroli_visits = data_dedup[gadchiroli_mask]

print("Total rows after deduplication:", len(data_dedup))
print("Gadchiroli visits count:", len(gadchiroli_visits))
print("Sample:")
print(gadchiroli_visits[['Visit ID','District','Village']].head(10))

import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/field_visit_log.xlsx'
df_raw = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Visit Log', header=None)
header_row = df_raw.iloc[4]
data = df_raw.iloc[5:].copy()
data.columns = header_row

# Ensure columns are strings
data.columns = [str(c) for c in data.columns]

# Drop rows where Visit ID is NaN or empty
data = data[data['Visit ID'].notna() & (data['Visit ID'].astype(str).str.strip() != '')]

# Normalize village
def normalize_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return ''
    s = str(v).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

data['Village_norm'] = data['Village'].apply(normalize_village)

# Normalize district for safety
def normalize_district(d):
    if pd.isna(d):
        return ''
    s = str(d).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

data['District_norm'] = data['District'].apply(normalize_district)

# Deduplicate by Visit ID keeping first occurrence (original order)
data_dedup = data.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')

# Count Gadchiroli
mask = data_dedup['District_norm'] == 'gadchiroli'
count = mask.sum()
print("Total rows after cleaning:", len(data))
print("Unique Visit IDs before dedup:", data['Visit ID'].nunique())
print("Rows after dedup:", len(data_dedup))
print("Gadchiroli count:", count)

# Also show distribution
print(data_dedup[mask]['Visit ID'].head(10).tolist())
